decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures such as Street Wraith and Striped Riverwinder, then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once. Utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Force of Negation to protect the combo, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence and potentially win the game in one explosive turn. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Grief and Boseiju, Who Endures to control the game and ensure the combo goes off smoothly.

The main concept of this Modern Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively control the board with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. Using cards like Blood Moon to disrupt opponents' mana bases and powerful removal spells like Terminate, the deck aims to maintain pressure while controlling the game. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide additional value by recurring creatures, and cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Castle Locthwain help generate card advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays with disruptive elements to secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game with a mix of removal spells, planeswalkers, and powerful creatures. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage and eventually overwhelming them with powerful threats like Omnath and Elesh Norn. With a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production and fixing, as well as versatile spells like Prismatic Ending, the deck can adapt to different matchups and situations. Overall, it seeks to dictate the pace of the game and secure victory through superior board presence and resource management.

This deck focuses on assembling the Amulet Titan combo by utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and Summoner's Pact to quickly ramp up mana and search for key pieces. The deck aims to efficiently use lands like Simic Growth Chamber and bounce lands to generate extra mana and get multiple land drops in a turn. Additionally, cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove help with land ramp and fixing, while Urza's Saga and The Mycosynth Gardens provide additional utility and value to the deck.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using Gemstone Caverns and Gemstone Mine, then use Glimpse of Tomorrow to exile cards from the library and put them onto the battlefield, aiming to bring out Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Omniscience for a game-winning play. Shardless Agent and Wavesifter help with card advantage and consistency, while Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Halo Forager provide support and protection. Force of Negation is used for defense, and Violent Outburst can be used to cascade into key spells. The deck focuses on explosive combos and powerful creature summons.

This deck focuses on casting spells with Cascade and maximizing value through free spells and card advantage. It aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with aggressive creatures and disruption to control the game state. The key strategy is to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone while utilizing Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect your game plan. Murktide Regent and Shardless Agent provide strong threats while generating card advantage. The deck seeks to maintain pressure and tempo by chaining cascades and outpacing opponents with efficient plays.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief. It utilizes powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the board with removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push. The deck also incorporates graveyard recursion with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Undying Malice, allowing for resilience and resource management. Overall, the deck aims to end the game quickly through aggressive plays and disruption.

The main goal of this deck is to control the game through various means such as Ensnaring Bridge, Spellskite, and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck aims to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant) to generate a large amount of mana and take advantage of Mystic Forge to cast spells off the top of the library. It also utilizes artifacts like Walking Ballista and Mishra's Bauble for additional control and utility. The deck is designed to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up a win condition through its powerful artifacts and lands.

The deck focuses on using cards like Architects of Will, Violent Outburst, and Living End to cycle through the deck and ultimately cascade into Living End, which allows you to bring all your creatures from your graveyard onto the battlefield. This combo can quickly overwhelm your opponent with powerful creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Striped Riverwinder. The deck also includes disruption like Grief and Force of Negation to disrupt your opponent's strategy and protect your combo. It aims to win the game by assembling the Living End combo efficiently.

The key concept of this deck is to consistently deal direct damage to the opponent as quickly as possible, with cards like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Searing Blaze. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent and end the game before they have a chance to stabilize. Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Guide help to increase the speed of the deck, while cards like Skullcrack and Boros Charm provide added versatility and protection against lifegain and removal. The deck also includes some land cards that can help filter through the deck for more burn spells.

This deck focuses on quickly casting cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone, it aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a mix of efficient creatures and versatile spells, it aims to establish board presence early and maintain control of the game through a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing +1/+1 counters and artifact synergy to overwhelm the opponent with efficient and resilient threats. By utilizing Hardened Scales and other cards that interact with counters, the deck aims to quickly build up creatures like Hangarback Walker and Walking Ballista to create a formidable board presence. The inclusion of Urza's Saga and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp adds additional value and versatility to the strategy, allowing for explosive plays and consistent pressure. The deck also features a toolbox of utility lands and spells to help maintain momentum and adapt to various matchups.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing a strong board presence with aggressive creatures like Wild Nacatl, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Scion of Draco. Tribal Flames and Leyline Binding add to the aggression by dealing direct damage to the opponent's life total or creatures. Stubborn Denial provides protection for your creatures and disruptive plays against the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for additional mana ramp and flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around rapid and relentless aggression to overwhelm the opponent and emerge victorious.

The deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty quickly. It also incorporates Teferi, Time Raveler to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The inclusion of Dwarven Mine and Leyline Binding provides additional support for the combo strategy. Additionally, the deck includes versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismari Command for removal and interaction. The deck aims to be proactive and creative in winning the game through its combo-centric strategy.

The main concept of this Living End deck is to cycle through the deck quickly, using powerful cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries to fill the graveyard with creatures. The goal is to then cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that allows you to bring all creatures from your graveyard onto the battlefield, while also disrupting your opponent's board with cards like Grief and Force of Negation. The deck also utilizes control elements like Violent Outburst to buy time until you can set up the combo for a big swing in your favor.

The main focus of this mono black control deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategies and slow down their game plan. By utilizing cards such as Night's Whisper, Fatal Push, and Bloodchief's Thirst to control the board, along with Karn, the Great Creator to shut down artifact-based strategies, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent. With the addition of cards like Relic of Progenitus and invoke despair to disrupt graveyard strategies and card draw, this deck can grind out victories through attrition and resource denial.
